knownDifferences.reason: the Linux WebKit reference (GStreamer) reports video/x-flv as playable, so video-ad-sdk picks the FLV file listed first and deviates; on macOS WebKit and Safari it skips the FLV file and S01 conforms

macOS WebKit only: rmp-vast builds its progress offsets once, on the first durationchange, and only if the duration is finite; in this engine the list stays empty, so no progress tracker fires (T05 to T07 deviate) and T19 is n/a
